sql: select `c`.`id` AS `id`,`c`.`name` AS `name`,`c`.`email` AS `contact_email`,`o`.`amount` AS `amount`,(case when (`o`.`status` = 'flagged') then `c`.`ssn` else NULL end) AS `flagged_ssn` from (`sandbox_db`.`customers` `c` join `sandbox_db`.`orders` `o` on((`c`.`id` = `o`.`customer_id`)))

select `sandbox_db`.`customer_orders_view`.`id` AS `id`,`sandbox_db`.`customer_orders_view`.`contact_email` AS `contact_email`,`sandbox_db`.`customer_orders_view`.`flagged_ssn` AS `flagged_ssn` from `sandbox_db`.`customer_orders_view` where (`sandbox_db`.`customer_orders_view`.`amount` > 1000)
